description: EFS file storage mount point, used to mount the file system on the client within the specified VPC and subnet

CreateTime.description: Creation time of the mount point

Domain.description: Domain name of the mount point

FileSystemId.description: ID of the associated file system

Ip.description: IP address of the mount point

PermissionGroupId.description: ID of the permission group bound to the mount point

PermissionGroupName.description: Name of the permission group bound to the mount point

Status.description: Status of the mount point. Creating: In progress; Running: Available; Updating: In progress; Deleting: In progress; CreateError: Creation failed; DeleteError: Deletion failed; Disabled: Disabled; Unknown: Unknown

SubnetId.description: ID of the subnet associated with the mount point

SubnetName.description: Name of the subnet associated with the mount point

UpdateTime.description: Last update time of the mount point

VpcId.description: ID of the VPC associated with the mount point

VpcName.description: Name of the VPC associated with the mount point

ZoneId.description: ID of the availability zone associated with the mount point

ZoneName.description: Name of the availability zone associated with the mount point
